.ss-avatar .ss-navicon{width:58px;height:58px;image-rendering:pixelated}
.ss-profile-head strong{font-size:18px;display:block}.ss-profile-head span:not(.ss-avatar):not(.ss-navicon){display:block;color:#e9e5bb;margin-top:3px;font-size:13px}.ss-profile-head small{display:block;color:#a5d5c5;margin-top:3px}
.ss-ui-subhead{margin:15px 0 9px;font-size:15px;color:#f6ecc3;border-left:3px solid #b4e6c5;padding-left:8px}
.ss-profile-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}.ss-stat-card{background:#183e4b;border:1px solid #88aaa4;border-radius:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 8px;font-size:12px;min-width:0}
.ss-stat-icon{font-size:18px;color:#d3efc0}.ss-stat-card b{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.ss-gear-list{background:#112c3d;border:1px solid #749b9c;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden}.ss-gear-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:35px 82px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #476a70;padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;min-height:48px}.ss-gear-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}.ss-gear-row strong{font-size:12px;text-align:right;line-height:1.3}.ss-gear-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:30px;height:30px;background:#345e69;border:1px solid #99c7b4;border-radius:6px;font-size:20px}
.ss-settings-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.ss-setting-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;background:#102e40;border:1px solid #648e94;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;min-height:55px}.ss-setting-item strong{font-size:14px}.ss-setting-item button{min-width:95px}.ss-setting-item input[type=range]{width:min(180px,52%);accent-color:#a3dec8}
.ss-ui-details{border:1px solid #608889;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 11px;margin-top:11px;background:#112c3b}.ss-ui-details summary{font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:850;touch-action:manipulation;min-height:28px}.ss-ui-details small{display:block;color:#b9ccc9;margin-top:9px;font-size:11px}
@media(max-width:380px){.ss-top-actions{gap:4px}.smallbtn.ss-navbtn{width:40px;height:43px;min-width:40px;min-height:43px}.ss-navicon{width:27px;height:27px}.brand small{letter-spacing:2.2px}.hudright .stats .chip{font-size:10px;padding:4px 6px}.ss-inv-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px}.ss-inv-tabs button{font-size:10px}.ss-stat-card{padding:6px 4px;gap:3px;font-size:11px}.ss-stat-card b{font-size:11px}.ss-gear-row{grid-template-columns:30px 66px 1fr;gap:5px;padding:8px 6px}.ss-gear-row strong{font-size:11px}.ss-profile-head{gap:9px}.ss-avatar{width:65px;height:65px}.dialog.ss-ui-modal{padding:12px}}
@media(max-height:480px) and (orientation:landscape){.dialog.ss-ui-modal{max-height:92dvh;padding:11px}.ss-ui-modal>h2{margin-bottom:9px;padding-bottom:8px}.ss-inv-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));min-height:0}.ss-item-detail{min-height:62px;padding:7px}.ss-detail-art{height:45px;width:45px;min-width:45px}.ss-settings-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.ss-profile-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}.ss-stat-card{flex-direction:column;gap:1px}.ss-gear-row{min-height:40px}}


/* SANDSTAR P0 A: non-modal, dropdown navigation below the existing top-right hamburger. */
#ssHubBackdrop[hidden],#ssHub[hidden]{display:none!important}
#ssHubBackdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:7;background:#0614217a;touch-action:manipulation}
#ssHub{position:absolute;z-index:8;width:min(316px,calc(100vw - 20px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 90px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;touch-action:pan-y;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#173b49,#102b3d 60%,#11293a);border:2px solid #d9ceaa;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 7px 0 #071825,0 16px 42px #0009;padding:11px 11px calc(11px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));color:#f6ecd1}
.ss-hub-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:5px 5px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #6b9391}
.ss-hub-top strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:950}
.ss-hub-close{min-width:39px;min-height:39px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid #a9d7cb;background:#214554;color:#fff1d1}
.ss-hub-summary{font-size:11px;color:#c9e7d3;padding:8px 7px 4px;font-weight:800}
.ss-hub-section{margin:8px 0 0;padding:0;border:0}
.ss-hub-section>h3{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#c2dfcf;margin:8px 6px 5px;font-weight:900}
.ss-hub-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:46px;margin:4px 0;padding:9px 11px;text-align:left;background:#18384a;border:1px solid #608c8b;color:#fff2d4;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:850;touch-action:manipulation}
.ss-hub-link:active{background:#2e6170;transform:translateY(1px)}
.ss-hub-link:focus-visible,.ss-hub-close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b8efc8;outline-offset:2px}
.ss-hub-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:27px;font-size:17px;color:#e4c88f}
.ss-hub-link .ss-hub-sub{margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:#b9d6d0;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:800}
#menuBtn[aria-expanded="true"]{border-color:#ffdfac;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#376776,#27485c)}
@media(max-height:480px) and (orientation:landscape){#ssHub{width:min(310px,calc(100vw - 20px));padding:7px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 14px)}.ss-hub-link{min-height:40px;padding:7px 9px}.ss-hub-section{margin-top:4px}}



/* Sandstar cargo P0: normal 20kg, max 30kg, ore-only cargo accounting. */
.ss-cargo-badge{font-size:11px;min-height:28px;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;touch-action:manipulation;background:#24493a;cursor:pointer}
.ss-cargo-badge.over{background:#715331;border-color:#e9ba70}
.ss-cargo-badge.full{background:#6e393e;border-color:#edaaa7}
.ss-cargo-meter{height:13px;background:#091d28;border:1px solid #86a7a1;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin:8px 0}
.ss-cargo-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8ad5b2,#e4c781);transition:width .1s}
.ss-cargo-fill.over{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#cca869,#e0a36b)}
.ss-cargo-fill.full{background:#df8b85}
.ss-cargo-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px}
.ss-cargo-summary>div{padding:10px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #517579;background:#122d3e;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.ss-cargo-summary b{font-size:17px;color:#ffe4aa}
.ss-cargo-summary small{font-size:11px;color:#c5d9d4}
.ss-cargo-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.ss-cargo-controls button{min-width:0;min-height:44px;white-space:normal}
.ss-cargo-ledger{margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;color:#e1eada}
@media(max-width:350px){.ss-cargo-badge{font-size:10px;padding:4px 5px}.ss-cargo-summary b{font-size:15px}.ss-cargo-controls button{font-size:11px}}
@media(max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape){.ss-cargo-badge{font-size:10px;padding:3px 5px}}

/* NARU playtest P0/P1: compact reason feedback and forge refresh */
#ssMineFeedback{position:absolute;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 165px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(430px,88vw);padding:7px 10px;text-align:center;background:#242c36f0;border:1px solid #e6c78b;border-radius:8px;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:800;color:#fff4d8;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
#ssMineFeedback.visible{opacity:1}
.ss-forge-result{background:#23473f;border:2px solid #a9dfb8;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:8px 0 10px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;justify-content:space-between}
.ss-forge-result strong{color:#e5ffd6;font-size:13px}
.ss-forge-result span{color:#d3eee2;font-size:11px}
.ss-forge-shortage{background:#422d35;border:1px solid #ffb7a2;color:#ffdfd2;padding:8px;border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.ss-forge-shortage small{color:#f9d3be}
.ss-forge-ready{color:#bce9c5;font-size:11px;margin-top:7px}
#tip .ss-guide-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:7px;pointer-events:auto}
#tip .ss-guide-actions[hidden]{display:none}
#tip .ss-guide-actions button{background:#234e54;border:1px solid #b3ddd0;border-radius:5px;color:#fff3d9;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 9px;min-height:30px}
.ss-hub-rescue{color:#ffe8c0!important}
@media(max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape){#ssMineFeedback{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 115px);max-width:48vw}#tip{max-width:min(300px,46vw)}}
@media(max-width:350px){#tip{max-width:min(260px,85vw)}#ssMineFeedback{font-size:10px;padding:5px 7px}}

/* P1.1 living tabs: touch friendly, without changing gameplay HUD */
.living-tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 0 12px;margin-top:8px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.living-tabs button{white-space:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #657c79;background:#1b333a;color:#e4f4e8;font-weight:700;min-height:42px}
.living-tabs button.selected{background:#466b51;border-color:#b3d5aa;color:white}
.living-content{max-height:min(53vh,420px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding-right:4px}
.living-content .line{gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:46px}
.living-content .line button{min-height:40px;margin:2px}
.living-content progress{width:100%;height:12px;accent-color:#8bd2ad}
.living-gauge{padding:12px;border:1px solid #668777;border-radius:10px;background:#18343a;margin:10px 0}
.living-route{padding:11px;border:1px solid #496657;border-radius:10px;background:#193a2b;line-height:1.7}
@media(max-width:500px){.living-tabs button{padding:9px 10px}.living-content{max-height:51vh}.living-content .line button{padding:8px 10px}}


/* M1.5: world HUD router, changing presentation but not the physics or save schema. */
#app.ss-hud-town .mine-direct-area,#app.ss-hud-forest .mine-direct-area{display:none!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#app.ss-hud-town #ropeBtn,#app.ss-hud-forest #ropeBtn,
#app.ss-hud-town #ropeHint,#app.ss-hud-forest #ropeHint{display:none!important;visibility:hidden!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#app.ss-hud-town #ssCargoBadge,#app.ss-hud-forest #ssCargoBadge,
#app.ss-hud-town #coords,#app.ss-hud-forest #coords,
#app.ss-hud-town #toolStatus,#app.ss-hud-forest #toolStatus,
#app.ss-hud-town .ss-mining-stat,#app.ss-hud-forest .ss-mining-stat{display:none!important}
#app.ss-hud-town #tip,#app.ss-hud-forest #tip{display:none!important}
#app.ss-hud-town #stationAction,#app.ss-hud-forest #stationAction{max-width:146px;right:12px;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 217px)}
#app.ss-hud-town .right-actions,#app.ss-hud-forest .right-actions{justify-content:flex-end;min-width:75px}
#app.ss-hud-town .joy-caption,#app.ss-hud-forest .joy-caption{font-size:10px}
#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge{pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 75px);left:10px;max-width:min(65vw,390px);width:auto;min-height:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-align:left;font:700 11px/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif;border:1px solid #9ac6a6;background:#153b3edc;color:#ecffef;padding:7px 10px}
#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge strong{font-size:11px;flex:0 0 auto}
#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge span{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:min(38vw,200px);font-weight:600}
#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe8b0}
#app:not(.ss-at-title).m15-quest-open #m1QuestBadge{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;max-width:min(84vw,380px)}
#app:not(.ss-at-title).m15-quest-open #m1QuestBadge span{white-space:normal;max-width:none}
#app.ss-hud-town #m1ActionBtn,#app.ss-hud-forest #m1ActionBtn{position:absolute;top:auto;right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 11px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 135px);min-width:104px;max-width:156px;min-height:52px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:14px;font-size:12px;z-index:7}
#m15ToolModeBtn{position:absolute;right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 13px);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 200px);z-index:7;min-width:100px;max-width:149px;min-height:44px;padding:7px 8px;border:1px solid #9cbea6;background:#173f42e8;border-radius:12px;font:800 11px/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff2c6;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #112633;touch-action:manipulation}
#m15ToolModeBtn[hidden],#app.ss-at-title #m15ToolModeBtn{display:none!important}
#app.ss-hud-mining[data-m15-manual="1"] #m15ToolModeBtn{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 210px);min-width:90px;background:#465545e8}
@media(max-width:680px){#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 61px);left:7px;max-width:66vw;font-size:10px;padding:6px 7px}#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge strong{display:none}#app.m15-quest-open:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge strong{display:block}#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge span{max-width:63vw}#app.ss-hud-town #m1ActionBtn,#app.ss-hud-forest #m1ActionBtn{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 102px);max-width:124px;min-width:93px;min-height:48px;font-size:10px}#m15ToolModeBtn{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 158px);max-width:124px;min-width:90px;font-size:10px}#app.ss-hud-town #stationAction,#app.ss-hud-forest #stationAction{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 213px);max-width:124px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:440px){#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 53px);max-width:48vw}#app.ss-hud-town #m1ActionBtn,#app.ss-hud-forest #m1ActionBtn{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 82px);right:8px;min-height:40px}#m15ToolModeBtn{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 133px);min-height:40px;right:8px}#app.ss-hud-town #stationAction,#app.ss-hud-forest #stationAction{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 181px);right:8px}}

/* M1.6: world gates are in-scene portals, never a permanent fast-travel toolbar. */
#m16TransitionCover{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:15;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background:#091d26f7;color:#f5ebbd;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .17s ease,visibility .17s ease;text-align:center;padding:24px}
#m16TransitionCover.active{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
#m16TransitionCover strong{font-size:clamp(21px,5vw,34px);letter-spacing:.09em;text-shadow:0 3px #07131d}
#m16TransitionCover span{font-size:12px;color:#c2e5d9;max-width:310px}
#app.ss-portal-transition #hud button,#app.ss-portal-transition #m1ActionBtn,#app.ss-portal-transition #m15ToolModeBtn{pointer-events:none!important}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#m16TransitionCover{transition:none}}

/* M1.7: direct in-world interaction, activity-specific controls, no extra permanent mining HUD. */
#m17ActivityOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:18;background:#081d2ab8;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-end;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 8px) 12px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 12px);box-sizing:border-box;pointer-events:auto}
#m17ActivityOverlay[hidden]{display:none!important}
#m17ActivityCard{width:min(100%,380px);max-height:min(73dvh,510px);box-sizing:border-box;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;border:2px solid #b9d9b7;border-radius:19px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#183e44,#122d38);box-shadow:0 12px 38px #071720e8;color:#f4f5dd;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;font:600 13px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:pan-y}
#m17ActivityCard h2{font:900 20px/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif;margin:0;color:#fff0b8}
#m17ActivityCard p{margin:0;color:#d8e5d8}
#m17ActivityCard .m17-info{font-size:11px;color:#a6ccca}
#m17ActivityCard .m17-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
#m17ActivityCard button{min-height:46px;border:1px solid #91bcae;border-radius:11px;background:#246a62;color:#fff5da;padding:9px 13px;font:800 13px/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif;touch-action:manipulation}
#m17ActivityCard .m17-actions button{flex:1 1 125px}
#m17ActivityCard button.m17-exit{background:#384b59;color:#e7f2f0;border-color:#6b8d96}
#m17ActivityCard button:disabled{opacity:.45;filter:grayscale(.25)}
#m17ActivityCard button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe4ab;outline-offset:2px}
#m17ActivityCard .m17-meters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
#m17ActivityCard .m17-meter{background:#09252d;border-radius:10px;padding:9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
#m17ActivityCard progress{width:100%;height:13px;accent-color:#7ab9a3}
#app.m17-activity-active #m1ActionBtn,#app.m17-activity-active #m15ToolModeBtn{pointer-events:none!important}
@media (orientation:landscape) and (max-height:440px){#m17ActivityOverlay{align-items:center;padding:6px calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 9px)}#m17ActivityCard{max-height:94dvh;width:min(88vw,550px);padding:10px 14px;gap:6px}#m17ActivityCard h2{font-size:17px}#m17ActivityCard button{min-height:42px}}

#farmForestGateAction{position:absolute;right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 13px);top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 226px);z-index:9;background:#20594ce9;border:2px solid #c4edbf;color:#ffffe2;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #102e29}
@media(max-width:920px) and (orientation:landscape){#farmForestGateAction{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 128px);padding:7px 10px;font-size:11px}}
/* Farm World M2.0 prototype: fully independent viewport and input, no modal/card frame. */
.farm-world[hidden], .farm-world [hidden]{display:none!important}
.farm-world{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:70;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#8cbf9a;touch-action:none}
#farmWorldCanvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;image-rendering:pixelated;touch-action:none}
.farm-world-hud{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;font-family:inherit;color:#f6f5d8;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #112d2c}
.farm-world-hud button,.farm-dpad{pointer-events:auto}
.farm-world-header{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 12px) 16px 13px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:linear-gradient(#133e37db,#163f3433,transparent)}
.farm-heading{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0}.farm-heading strong{font-size:clamp(19px,2.6vw,30px);color:#ffe5a4}.farm-heading small{font-size:11px;color:#d5ffdc}
.farm-kicker{font:800 9px system-ui;letter-spacing:2px;color:#ace5b6}
.farm-stats{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.farm-stats>div{background:#193f36de;border:1px solid #9ccba0ad;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 3px #0b2c29a6}
.farm-world-guide{position:absolute;left:16px;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 90px);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;background:#183a2eae;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:7px;max-width:70vw}
.farm-world-bottom{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 10px);padding:0 16px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.farm-dpad{width:clamp(108px,14vw,146px);height:clamp(108px,14vw,146px);border:3px solid #d7f3d0;background:#193e38d9;border-radius:50%;position:relative;flex:none;touch-action:none;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #133129,0 0 0 4px #35624c80}
.farm-dpad-ring{position:absolute;inset:20%;border:2px solid #9dd4ac88;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}.farm-dpad-icon{position:absolute;top:25%;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:46px;color:#ffe7b9;pointer-events:none}.farm-dpad-note{position:absolute;bottom:8px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;pointer-events:none}
.farm-bottom-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;max-width:70%}
.farm-seeds{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:end}.farm-seeds button{min-height:36px;border-radius:9px;background:#164d43db;border:1px solid #9cd8bb;padding:5px 10px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.farm-seeds button.selected{background:#d0ad64;color:#18302d;text-shadow:none;border-color:#fff1bb}
.farm-world-action{min-height:58px;width:min(252px,55vw);border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #def4c9;background:#17544fe8;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 5px #0a2b2c}
.farm-world-action:disabled{opacity:.7;cursor:default}.farm-world-exit{min-height:42px;border:1px solid #b9dfb9;background:#305448ec;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;padding:7px 12px}
.farm-world-toast{position:absolute;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 125px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#102b25e8;border:1px solid #b9debb;color:#fff6d2;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;max-width:85%;text-align:center}.farm-world-toast.show{opacity:1}
@media(max-width:920px) and (orientation:landscape){.farm-world-header{padding:5px 12px}.farm-heading strong{font-size:17px}.farm-heading small{font-size:10px}.farm-kicker{font-size:8px}.farm-stats{font-size:10px}.farm-stats>div{padding:4px 6px}.farm-world-guide{top:56px;left:12px;font-size:10px}.farm-world-bottom{padding:0 12px;bottom:8px}.farm-dpad{width:102px;height:102px}.farm-dpad-icon{font-size:35px}.farm-world-action{width:178px;min-height:52px;font-size:12px}.farm-seeds button{min-height:31px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:10px}.farm-world-exit{min-height:33px;font-size:11px}.farm-world-toast{top:82px}}
@media(max-width:520px) and (orientation:portrait){.farm-world-header{padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 8px) 10px 9px}.farm-heading strong{font-size:19px}.farm-stats{font-size:9px;max-width:49%;white-space:normal;text-align:right}.farm-stats>div{padding:4px 5px}.farm-world-guide{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 88px);left:10px;font-size:10px;max-width:calc(100vw - 20px)}.farm-keyhint{display:none}.farm-world-bottom{padding:0 12px;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 17px)}.farm-dpad{width:118px;height:118px}.farm-bottom-right{max-width:58%}.farm-world-action{width:min(205px,52vw);min-height:64px;font-size:13px}.farm-seeds button{padding:4px 6px;font-size:10px}.farm-world-toast{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 121px)}}

/* M2.1: independent 3D archaeology world, not an overlay activity. */
.arch-world[hidden],.arch-world [hidden]{display:none!important}
.arch-world{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:78;background:#0b1b28;color:#f5efce;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}
.arch-world canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none}
.arch-world #archWorldGpu{z-index:1}.arch-world #archWorldFallback{z-index:2}
.arch-world .arch-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 51% 46%,transparent 45%,#09132190 100%)}
.arch-world .arch-hud{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;color:#f5edcf;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #06121c}
.arch-world .arch-hud button,.arch-world .arch-pad{pointer-events:auto}
.arch-world .arch-header{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 12px) calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 18px) 16px calc(env(safe-area-inset-left) + 16px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;background:linear-gradient(#0b2236e9,#10314299,transparent)}
.arch-world .arch-heading{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;max-width:60vw}
.arch-world .arch-kicker{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;color:#8ed6d4}
.arch-world .arch-heading strong{font-size:clamp(19px,2.65vw,28px);line-height:1.2;color:#ffe1a0}
.arch-world .arch-heading small{color:#cce6df;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3}
.arch-world .arch-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:5px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.arch-world .arch-chip{border:1px solid #79a9aa80;background:#113342d9;border-radius:9px;padding:6px 9px;white-space:nowrap}
.arch-world .arch-guide{position:absolute;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 93px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);max-width:70vw;text-align:center;border:1px solid #7ba7ab77;background:#102938ba;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 11px;font-size:11px;color:#e2eadc}
.arch-world .arch-pad{position:absolute;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 22px);left:calc(env(safe-area-inset-left) + 19px);width:126px;height:126px;border-radius:50%;background:#183748c8;border:3px solid #a7d5c2;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #0a1d29,0 0 0 4px #122b3899;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:33px;color:#ebd59f;user-select:none;touch-action:none}
.arch-world .arch-pad span{pointer-events:none}.arch-world .arch-pad small{position:absolute;bottom:10px;font-size:10px;color:#d9ebe0;font-weight:800}
.arch-world .arch-actions{position:absolute;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 17px);right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 19px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px}
.arch-world .arch-actions button{border:2px solid #c2dbc1;background:#205950ec;color:#f2f5d8;border-radius:14px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #0c2728}
.arch-world .arch-actions button:disabled{opacity:.55}.arch-world .arch-actions .arch-action{min-width:136px;min-height:66px;background:#226668}
.arch-world .arch-actions .arch-camera{background:#2b3c53;border-color:#98b8ba;font-size:11px;min-height:38px}
.arch-world .arch-toast{position:absolute;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 163px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:max-content;max-width:min(470px,85vw);padding:8px 13px;border-radius:11px;background:#122c36e8;border:1px solid #acd4ba;color:#f5e6b7;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity .16s;pointer-events:none}
.arch-world .arch-toast.show{opacity:1}
@media(max-height:540px) and (orientation:landscape){.arch-world .arch-header{padding-top:5px;padding-bottom:5px}.arch-world .arch-heading strong{font-size:19px}.arch-world .arch-heading small{font-size:9px}.arch-world .arch-chip{padding:3px 6px;font-size:9px}.arch-world .arch-guide{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 54px);font-size:9px;padding:3px 9px}.arch-world .arch-pad{width:95px;height:95px;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 8px);font-size:25px}.arch-world .arch-pad small{bottom:5px}.arch-world .arch-actions{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 9px);gap:5px}.arch-world .arch-actions .arch-action{min-height:49px;min-width:120px;font-size:12px}.arch-world .arch-actions .arch-camera{min-height:32px;padding:5px 9px}.arch-world .arch-toast{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 104px)}}
@media(max-width:420px) and (orientation:portrait){.arch-world .arch-header{padding-left:10px;padding-right:10px}.arch-world .arch-heading{max-width:58vw}.arch-world .arch-heading strong{font-size:19px}.arch-world .arch-heading small{font-size:10px}.arch-world .arch-right{font-size:9px}.arch-world .arch-guide{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 114px);max-width:85vw;font-size:10px}.arch-world .arch-pad{width:108px;height:108px;left:12px;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 21px)}.arch-world .arch-actions{right:12px}.arch-world .arch-actions button{font-size:12px}.arch-world .arch-actions .arch-action{min-width:115px}}


/* M2.3: full-scene WorldForge-compatible 2.5D town world; no popup mini-game. */
.town-25d[hidden],.town-25d [hidden]{display:none!important}
.town-25d{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:72;overflow:hidden;background:#79aba4;touch-action:none;color:#f4efd3}
.town-25d canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}
.town-25d .t25-vignette{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#10343c5c 0%,transparent 22%,transparent 70%,#081d283a 100%)}
.town-25d .t25-hud{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #142d33}
.town-25d button,.town-25d .t25-pad{pointer-events:auto}
.town-25d .t25-header{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 9px) calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 14px) 5px calc(env(safe-area-inset-left) + 13px);background:linear-gradient(#0c3544cc,transparent)}
.town-25d .t25-title{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.town-25d .t25-kicker{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#a4dfd4}
.town-25d .t25-title strong{font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,28px);color:#ffe7ae}
.town-25d .t25-title small{font-size:11px;color:#e1f5dd}
.town-25d .t25-chips{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;max-width:50%}
.town-25d .t25-chip,.town-25d .t25-chips button{border:1px solid #aed2b4a9;background:#103e46cf;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:13px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;color:#f0ebd0}
.town-25d .t25-chips button{min-height:40px;cursor:pointer}
.town-25d .t25-help{position:absolute;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 95px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#0c3037bb;border:1px solid #aacdbaa1;border-radius:14px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;max-width:68vw;text-align:center;white-space:normal}
.town-25d .t25-footer{position:absolute;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 12px);left:calc(env(safe-area-inset-left) + 14px);right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right) + 14px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.town-25d .t25-pad{width:134px;height:134px;flex:0 0 134px;position:relative;border-radius:50%;border:4px solid #acd5bb;background:#133d48d8;box-shadow:0 7px 0 #0a2934aa,inset 0 0 0 2px #2e6e67;touch-action:none;user-select:none;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;font-size:35px;color:#eedba4}
.town-25d .t25-pad:after{content:'이동';position:absolute;bottom:13px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#e0f4ea}
.town-25d .t25-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:8px;pointer-events:none}
.town-25d .t25-right button{border:2px solid #bad6b9;color:#fff4d8;background:#246762eb;border-radius:16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:900;padding:12px 14px;min-height:46px;max-width:min(210px,48vw);box-shadow:0 4px 0 #0e3036a3}
.town-25d .t25-right button.t25-primary{min-height:67px;min-width:136px;background:#195d64ed}
.town-25d .t25-toast{position:absolute;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 130px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;border:1px solid #c9d7b0;border-radius:13px;background:#113843df;padding:7px 12px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;max-width:75vw;pointer-events:none}
.town-25d .t25-toast.show{opacity:1}
#app.town-25d-active #overlay{z-index:94}
#app.town-25d-active #m16TransitionCover{z-index:97}
#app.town-25d-active #startScreen{z-index:99}
@media(max-height:520px) and (orientation:landscape){.town-25d .t25-header{padding-top:5px}.town-25d .t25-title strong{font-size:19px}.town-25d .t25-kicker{font-size:8px}.town-25d .t25-title small{font-size:9px}.town-25d .t25-help{top:53px;font-size:9px;padding:3px 8px}.town-25d .t25-pad{width:96px;height:96px;flex-basis:96px;font-size:29px}.town-25d .t25-pad:after{font-size:10px;bottom:7px}.town-25d .t25-footer{bottom:6px}.town-25d .t25-right button{font-size:11px;min-height:35px;padding:7px 11px}.town-25d .t25-right button.t25-primary{min-height:48px}.town-25d .t25-chips button,.town-25d .t25-chip{padding:4px 6px;font-size:9px;min-height:30px}.town-25d .t25-toast{top:85px}}
@media(max-width:520px) and (orientation:portrait){.town-25d .t25-title strong{font-size:22px}.town-25d .t25-title small{font-size:10px}.town-25d .t25-kicker{font-size:8px}.town-25d .t25-chip{font-size:10px}.town-25d .t25-help{top:92px;width:70vw;font-size:10px}.town-25d .t25-pad{width:121px;height:121px;flex-basis:121px}.town-25d .t25-right button.t25-primary{min-width:125px}}


/* SANDSTAR M2.5-C: farm and ruins readiness-gated world transitions. */
#app.ss-portal-transition #farmWorldRoot,#app.ss-portal-transition #archWorldRoot{pointer-events:none!important}
/* SANDSTAR M2.5-A: full-world loading artwork, not an in-world modal. */
#m16TransitionCover{--m25-glow:#81c7a6;--m25-ink:#071e2b;--m25-soft:#d5eedb;position:absolute;inset:0;inset-block:0;inset-inline:0;z-index:150!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:0;overflow:hidden;padding:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(19px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-left));
 background:radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 46% at 50% 47%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--m25-glow) 22%,transparent),transparent 85%),linear-gradient(152deg,#132f39,var(--m25-ink) 62%,#071720);color:#ffeed0;text-align:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .23s ease,visibility .23s;touch-action:none;isolation:isolate}
#m16TransitionCover.active{opacity:1;visibility:visible;pointer-events:auto}
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="village_hub_01"]{--m25-glow:#91d2ae;--m25-ink:#103e48;--m25-soft:#e2f3d8}
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="mine"]{--m25-glow:#c6a66e;--m25-ink:#182d34;--m25-soft:#f2deb3}
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="life_forest_01"]{--m25-glow:#66b98a;--m25-ink:#103a36;--m25-soft:#cef0d0}
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="farm_01"]{--m25-glow:#e4c583;--m25-ink:#304238;--m25-soft:#faf0c8}
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="ruins_3d_01"]{--m25-glow:#63cfd5;--m25-ink:#091f33;--m25-soft:#c5f4ef}
#m16TransitionCover:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,#fff1 0px,#fff1 1px,transparent 1px,transparent 43px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#fff1 0px,#fff1 1px,transparent 1px,transparent 43px);opacity:.13;z-index:-1}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-stars{pointer-events:none;position:absolute;inset:5% 6%;opacity:.33;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#d5fff0 0 1px,transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle,#d5fff0 0 1px,transparent 2px);background-size:174px 104px,231px 137px;background-position:10px 8px,70px 55px}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-brand{position:relative;align-self:flex-start;font:900 clamp(10px,1.1vw,12px)/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#d7f1de;text-shadow:0 2px #08212b;z-index:2}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-brand-sub{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.09em;opacity:.67}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-mark{font-size:21px;color:var(--m25-glow);margin-right:5px}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-content{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;width:min(100%,760px);min-height:0;flex:1 1 auto;gap:0;z-index:1}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-scene{width:min(93vw,720px);height:clamp(145px,37vh,330px);position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:4px}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-scene:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:4%;left:15%;right:15%;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--m25-glow),transparent);opacity:.63}
#m25SceneArt{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 21px #00192273)}
#m25SceneArt .m25-art{display:none}
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="village_hub_01"] #m25SceneArt .m25-art-town,
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="mine"] #m25SceneArt .m25-art-mine,
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="life_forest_01"] #m25SceneArt .m25-art-forest,
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="farm_01"] #m25SceneArt .m25-art-farm,
#m16TransitionCover[data-world="ruins_3d_01"] #m25SceneArt .m25-art-ruins{display:block}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-index{font:900 10px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.27em;color:var(--m25-glow);margin:6px 0 8px}
#m16TransitionCover #m16TransitionTitle{display:block;font:950 clamp(32px,6vw,60px)/1.18 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.055em;color:#fff1cf;max-width:100%;text-wrap:balance;text-shadow:0 5px 18px #0519239c}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-subtitle{font:700 clamp(12px,2.2vw,16px)/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--m25-soft);margin-top:7px;letter-spacing:.03em;max-width:80vw}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-rule{height:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;color:var(--m25-glow);opacity:.8;font-size:14px}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-rule:before,#m16TransitionCover .m25-rule:after{content:"";width:58px;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.45}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-tip{border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--m25-glow) 39%,transparent);background:#061f2c88;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 18px;max-width:min(90vw,510px);color:#edf5de;font:600 clamp(11px,1.5vw,13px)/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;word-break:keep-all}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-footer{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:7px;flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;z-index:2}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-loading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;height:11px}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-loading i{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--m25-glow);animation:m25Pulse 1.08s ease-in-out infinite;box-shadow:0 0 7px var(--m25-glow)}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-loading i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.16s}#m16TransitionCover .m25-loading i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.32s}
@keyframes m25Pulse{0%,75%,100%{opacity:.24;transform:scale(.7)}38%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.45)}}
#m16TransitionCover #m16TransitionSubtitle{font:700 12px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#d9efdf;max-width:90vw;letter-spacing:.02em}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-footer small{font:750 9px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#a4c9be;opacity:.75}
#m16TransitionCover .m25-foot-dot{color:var(--m25-glow)}
@media(max-height:540px) and (min-width:550px){#m16TransitionCover{padding:9px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 9px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}#m16TransitionCover .m25-mark{font-size:14px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-content{min-height:0}#m16TransitionCover .m25-scene{height:clamp(90px,34vh,160px);margin-bottom:0}#m16TransitionCover .m25-index{font-size:8px;margin:0 0 2px}#m16TransitionCover #m16TransitionTitle{font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,34px)}#m16TransitionCover .m25-subtitle{font-size:11px;margin-top:2px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-rule{height:14px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-tip{padding:5px 12px;font-size:10px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-footer{gap:3px}#m16TransitionCover #m16TransitionSubtitle{font-size:10px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-footer small{font-size:7px}}
@media(max-width:460px) and (orientation:portrait){#m16TransitionCover{padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 22px) 14px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 28px)}#m16TransitionCover .m25-brand{font-size:9px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-brand-sub{font-size:8px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-scene{height:clamp(158px,29vh,245px);width:100%}#m16TransitionCover .m25-index{margin:10px 0 9px}#m16TransitionCover #m16TransitionTitle{font-size:clamp(30px,9vw,42px)}#m16TransitionCover .m25-subtitle{margin-top:10px}#m16TransitionCover .m25-tip{border-radius:17px;padding:11px 13px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#m16TransitionCover{transition:none}#m16TransitionCover .m25-loading i{animation:none;opacity:1}}


/* SS-HUD-PATCH-20261118: only mobile action placement and quest position */
#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 93px)}
@media(max-width:680px){#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 80px)}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:440px){#app:not(.ss-at-title) #m1QuestBadge{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 66px)}}
#app #m1ActionBtn[data-action="mine-exit"]{position:absolute;top:auto;right:auto;left:50%;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + clamp(132px,19vh,164px));transform:translateX(-50%);min-width:170px;max-width:min(72vw,245px);min-height:48px;padding:8px 12px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;z-index:8}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:440px){#app #m1ActionBtn[data-action="mine-exit"]{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 96px);max-width:min(45vw,230px);min-width:150px;min-height:40px;font-size:11px}}
/* Mine exit remains centered but clears the independent station button on narrow portrait screens. */
@media(max-width:680px) and (orientation:portrait){#app #m1ActionBtn[data-action="mine-exit"]{bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + clamp(238px,30vh,270px))}}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<main id="app">
<canvas id="world" aria-label="흙별의 픽셀 오픈월드"></canvas><div class="vignette"></div>
<div id="hud">
  <header id="header">
    <div class="brandbox"><div class="brand">흙<em>별</em><small>S A N D S T A R</small></div><button id="placeBadge" type="button" class="hintbadge" aria-label="광부 프로필 열기"><span class="icontext tight"><span class="ico sm" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>초록 평원</span></span></button></div>
    <div class="hudright"><div class="stats"><div class="chip"><span class="ico sm" data-asset="coin" aria-hidden="true"></span> <b id="coins">0</b> <span aria-hidden="true">·</span> <span class="ss-mining-stat"><span class="ico sm" data-asset="pickaxe" aria-hidden="true"></span> <b id="mined">0</b></span></div><div class="chip" id="coords">X 0 · Y 0</div><button class="chip ss-cargo-badge" id="ssCargoBadge" type="button" aria-label="원정 화물 관리 열기">🎒 0.0kg</button></div><div class="ss-top-actions"><button class="smallbtn ss-navbtn" id="inventoryBtn" type="button" title="광물·보석 인벤토리" aria-label="광물과 보석 인벤토리 열기"><span class="ss-ore-icon" aria-hidden="true">◆</span></button><button class="smallbtn ss-navbtn" id="bagBtn" type="button" title="장비·유물 가방" aria-label="장비와 유물 가방 열기"><span class="ss-navicon ss-bag" aria-hidden="true"></span></button><button class="smallbtn ss-navbtn" id="menuBtn" type="button" title="전체 메뉴" aria-label="전체 메뉴 열기" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="ssHub"></button></div></div>
  </header>
  <div id="tip"><span class="icontext"><span class="ico sm" data-asset="notice" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="k">흙별 채굴 조작 안내</span></span><br><span id="tiptext">왼손 방향패드로 이동 · 오른쪽 채굴 패드로 8방향 채굴 · 로프·점프를 활용해 탐험하세요.</span><div class="ss-guide-actions" id="ssGuideActions" hidden><button id="ssGuideNext" type="button">다음</button><button id="ssGuideSkip" type="button">건너뛰기</button></div></div>
  <div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><div id="ssMineFeedback" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></div>
  <button id="stationAction" aria-label="가까운 승강장 열기"></button>
  <footer id="footer">
   <div id="controls" aria-label="왼쪽 8방향 이동 패드, 오른쪽 독립 채굴 패드 로프 점프 조작">
    <div class="mine-area"><div id="toolStatus" class="equip" aria-live="polite"></div>
      <div id="mineStick" class="mine-stick" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="8방향 이동 및 로프 조준 패드" aria-pressed="false">
        <span class="dir" data-dir="-1,-1" aria-hidden="true">↖</span><span class="dir" data-dir="0,-1" aria-hidden="true">↑</span><span class="dir" data-dir="1,-1" aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
        <span class="dir" data-dir="-1,0" aria-hidden="true">←</span><span class="dir" data-dir="1,0" aria-hidden="true">→</span>
        <span class="dir" data-dir="-1,1" aria-hidden="true">↙</span><span class="dir" data-dir="0,1" aria-hidden="true">↓</span><span class="dir" data-dir="1,1" aria-hidden="true">↘</span>
        <span id="stickKnob" class="stick-knob" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      </div><div id="m15MoveCaption" class="joy-caption" aria-hidden="true">이동 · 로프 조준</div></div>
    <div class="right-actions" role="group" aria-label="오른손 독립 채굴 로프 점프 액션">
      <div class="mine-direct-area">
        <div id="mineDirectPad" class="mine-stick mine-direct" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="독립 8방향 채굴 패드. 눌러 즉시 채굴하고 드래그로 방향 변경" aria-pressed="false">
          <span class="dir" data-dir="-1,-1" aria-hidden="true">↖</span><span class="dir" data-dir="0,-1" aria-hidden="true">↑</span><span class="dir" data-dir="1,-1" aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
          <span class="dir" data-dir="-1,0" aria-hidden="true">←</span><span class="dir" data-dir="1,0" aria-hidden="true">→</span>
          <span class="dir" data-dir="-1,1" aria-hidden="true">↙</span><span class="dir" data-dir="0,1" aria-hidden="true">↓</span><span class="dir" data-dir="1,1" aria-hidden="true">↘</span>
          <span id="mineCursor" class="stick-knob" aria-hidden="true">⛏</span>
        </div>
        <div class="mine-direct-caption" aria-hidden="true">채굴 · 8방향</div>
      </div>
      <div class="jump-area" role="group" aria-label="로프 및 점프 액션">
        <div class="action-secondary"><button class="control" id="jump" aria-label="점프"><span class="jumpicon ico btn" data-asset="jump" aria-hidden="true"></span><small id="jumpLabel">점프</small></button></div>
        <div class="rope-wrap"><div id="ropeHint" aria-hidden="true"></div><button id="ropeBtn" aria-label="누른 채 왼쪽 방향패드로 조준하거나 직접 드래그"></button></div>
      </div>
    </div>
   </div>
  </footer>
</div>

<!-- Title scene is deliberately local and pauses the original simulation. -->
<div id="startScreen" class="ss-start visible" role="region" aria-labelledby="ssTitle">
 <div class="ss-grain" aria-hidden="true"></div>
 <div class="ss-layout">
  <div class="ss-hero">
    <span class="ss-eyebrow"><i class="ss-diamond"></i> 끝없는 땅 아래, 또 하나의 세계</span>
    <h1 class="ss-name" id="ssTitle">흙<span>별</span></h1>
    <div class="ss-en">SANDSTAR</div>
    <p class="ss-tagline">한 칸 더 파고, 한 번 더 오르고.<br>나만의 별에 첫 발자국을 남기세요.</p>
    <p class="ss-quote">채굴 · 탐험 · 제작 · 로프 액션 · 나만의 세계</p>
  </div>
  <div class="ss-panel" id="ssMainPanel">
    <div id="ssHome" class="ss-view">
     <p class="ss-panel-eyebrow"><span class="ss-led"></span> ADVENTURE LOG</p>
     <h2 class="ss-panel-heading">어디서 이어갈까요?</h2>
     <p class="ss-panel-sub">시작 전에는 월드 시간이 흐르지 않아요.</p>
     <div class="ss-worldcard" aria-live="polite">
      <span class="ss-gem" id="ssSaveStatus">WORLD STATUS</span>
      <strong id="ssSaveInfo">월드를 확인하고 있어요</strong>
      <small id="ssSaveHint">기존 저장을 안전하게 찾는 중</small>
     </div>
     <div class="ss-actions">
      <button id="ssContinue" class="ss-btn primary" disabled><span>이어하기<small style="display:block">마지막 탐험으로 돌아가기</small></span><span class="ss-arrow" aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>
      <button id="ssNew" class="ss-btn secondary"><span>새 월드 시작<small style="display:block">새로운 땅을 생성해요</small></span><span class="ss-arrow" aria-hidden="true">＋</span></button>
      <div class="ss-duo"><button id="ssSettings" class="ss-btn ghost">⚙ 환경 설정</button><button id="ssFullscreen" class="ss-btn ghost">⛶ 전체 화면</button></div>
      <button id="ssBackup" class="ss-btn ghost" hidden>↓ 저장 월드 백업</button>
     </div>
     <p class="ss-foot">다섯 세계를 잇는 모험 · 진행 상황 자동 저장</p>
    </div>
    <div id="ssSettingsView" class="ss-view" hidden>
     <button class="ss-back" data-ss-back type="button">← 메인으로</button>
     <p class="ss-panel-eyebrow">SETTINGS</p>
     <h2 class="ss-panel-heading">환경 설정</h2>
     <p class="ss-panel-sub">조작하기 편한 모험 환경을 골라요.</p>
     <div class="ss-setting-row"><div><strong>배경음악</strong><small>흙과 별 사이 · 메인 테마 60초 루프</small></div><button class="ss-btn ghost" id="ssBgmToggle" aria-pressed="true">켜짐</button></div>
     <div class="ss-setting-row"><label for="ssBgmVolume">배경음악 크기</label><input type="range" id="ssBgmVolume" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="20" aria-label="배경음악 크기"></div>
     <div class="ss-setting-row"><div><strong>효과음</strong><small>채굴·발견·도약 효과음</small></div><button class="ss-btn ghost" id="ssSound" aria-pressed="true">켜짐</button></div>
     <div class="ss-setting-row"><label for="ssVolume">효과음 크기</label><input type="range" id="ssVolume" min="0" max="100" step="5" value="30" aria-label="효과음 크기"></div>
     <div class="ss-setting-row"><div><strong>로프 진동</strong><small>기기가 지원할 때만 동작</small></div><button class="ss-btn ghost" id="ssHaptics" aria-pressed="true">켜짐</button></div>
     <div class="ss-setting-row"><div><strong>로프 물리 실험</strong><small>기본 B 탄성 · 접근성 A 고정</small></div><button type="button" class="ss-btn ghost" id="ssRopeAB" aria-label="로프 물리 A 또는 B 전환">A · 고정</button></div>
     <div class="ss-setting-row"><div><strong>전체 화면</strong><small>브라우저가 허용하는 경우</small></div><button class="ss-btn ghost" id="ssFullscreenSettings">전환</button></div>
     <p class="ss-notice" id="ssSettingsNote" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <div id="ssConfirmView" class="ss-view" hidden>
     <button class="ss-back" data-ss-back type="button">← 취소하고 돌아가기</button>
     <p class="ss-panel-eyebrow">NEW WORLD</p>
     <h2 class="ss-panel-heading">새로운 흙별</h2>
     <p class="ss-panel-sub">완전히 다른 지형에서 시작합니다.</p>
     <div class="ss-warn" id="ssOverwriteWarning">저장된 월드가 있으면 이 브라우저의 기존 진행 기록이 덮어써집니다. 필요한 경우 먼저 백업하세요.</div>
     <div class="ss-actions">
      <button id="ssConfirmBackup" class="ss-btn ghost">↓ 기존 월드 파일 백업</button>
      <button id="ssConfirmCreate" class="ss-btn primary">새 월드 만들기 <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
      <button data-ss-back class="ss-btn secondary">기존 월드 유지</button>
     </div>
     <p class="ss-notice" id="ssConfirmNote" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>
<div id="ssBootLoader" class="ss-start-loader" role="status" aria-live="polite"><span>흙별의 지형을 읽는 중</span><div class="ss-loading-bar" aria-hidden="true"></div></div>

 </div>

<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),cv=$('world'),ctx=cv.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});
const T=27, WW=512, WH=192, LEGACY_SAVE_KEY='sandstar-p1-world-v1', PREVIOUS_LIVING_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':living-v101-merge-sandbox', PREVIOUS_P11_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':living-p11-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M1_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':zanbit-forest-m1-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M15_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':world-ui-m15-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M16_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':world-portals-m16-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M17_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':living-interactions-m17-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M20_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':farm-world-m20-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M21_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':arch-world-m21-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M22_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':town-hub-m22-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M23_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':town-25d-m23-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M24_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':town-assets-m24-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M25B_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':world-loading-m25b-sandbox', PREVIOUS_M25C_SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':world-loading-m25c-sandbox', SAVE_KEY=LEGACY_SAVE_KEY+':official-m25d';
// Cargo P0 production: existing save key preserved; carried ores only count after update.
// 2.7: player occupies a single tile, and every mining route shares one 2-tile limit.
const PLAYER_DRAW_SIZE=T, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH=.34, PLAYER_HEIGHT=.92, PLAYER_CENTER_FROM_FEET=.5, MAX_MINE_REACH=2;
const MATERIAL_NAMES={dirt:'흙',stone:'돌',wood:'원목',wall:'나무 벽',glass:'유리',torch:'횃불',bed:'침대',chest:'상자',copper:'구리',iron:'철',crystal:'수정',titanium:'티타늄',starshard:'별조각',orecoal:'석탄',amber:'호박석',opal:'오팔',relic:'고대 유물'};
const TOOL_INFO={pickaxe:{name:'곡괭이',icon:'pickaxe',tag:'균형 잡힌 채굴',price:0},drill:{name:'전동 드릴',icon:'drill',tag:'광석·단단한 돌 가속',price:180},hammer:{name:'충격 망치',icon:'hammer',tag:'주변 블록 충격파',price:250}};
// 2.10: embedded original PNG icon atlas. No SVG DOM or external asset fetch.
const UI_ICON_IDS=Object.freeze(["coin", "pickaxe", "drill", "hammer", "market", "menu", "station", "rope", "jump", "notice", "meadow", "forest", "desert", "snow", "highlands", "underground", "deep", "abyss"]);
const asset=(name,cls='md')=>`<span class="ico ${cls}" data-icon="${UI_ICON_IDS.includes(name)?name:'notice'}" aria-hidden="true"></span>`;
function setAssetHTML(el,name,label=''){if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=label?`<span class="icontext">${asset(name,'md')}<span>${label}</span></span>`:asset(name,'md');}
function toolLabel(id){const t=TOOL_INFO[id]||TOOL_INFO.pickaxe;return `${asset(t.icon,'sm')} ${t.name}`;}
function placeInfo(depth,biome){if(depth<5){const label={meadow:'초록 평원',forest:'반딧불 숲',desert:'황금 사막',snow:'눈꽃 설원',highlands:'높은 산지'}[biome]||'미지 지역';return {icon:biome,label};}if(depth<18)return {icon:'underground',label:'지표 아래'};if(depth<45)return {icon:'deep',label:'깊은 동굴'};return {icon:'abyss',label:'심층 동굴'};}
function applyStaticUiAssets(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-asset]').forEach(el=>{const n=el.getAttribute('data-asset');el.removeAttribute('data-asset');el.setAttribute('data-icon',UI_ICON_IDS.includes(n)?n:'notice');});setAssetHTML($('menuBtn'),'menu');$('stationAction').innerHTML=`${asset('station','md')}<span>승강장 이동</span>`;$('ropeBtn').innerHTML='<img class="duri-rope-coil" alt="" aria-hidden="true" src="data:image/png;base64,"><span class="duri-rope-label">로프</span>';$('stickKnob').innerHTML=asset('pickaxe','btn');$('jumpLabel').textContent='점프';}
const SOLIDS=new Set(['dirt','grass','stone','stationrock','wood','iron','copper','crystal','titanium','starshard','glass','bed','chest','orecoal','snow','sand','amber','opal','relic']);
const ORES=new Set(['copper','iron','crystal','titanium','starshard','orecoal','amber','opal']);

// 2026-11-12 cargo P0. All weights and capacity/speed factors are proposals, not DAVE values.
// Older inventory is excluded to prevent retroactive overload; only ore/gems mined after update count.
const SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS=Object.freeze({orecoal:.6,copper:.8,iron:1.1,crystal:.9,titanium:1.4,starshard:.7,amber:.65,opal:.45});
const SS_CARGO_NORMAL=20, SS_CARGO_MAX=30;
let ssCargoToastAt=-1e9;
let ssMineNoticeAt=-1e9,ssMineNoticeMessage='';
function ssMineNotice(msg,force=false){
 const now=performance.now(),el=$('ssMineFeedback');
 if(!msg||!el||(!force&&now-ssMineNoticeAt<1600))return;
 ssMineNoticeAt=now;ssMineNoticeMessage=msg;el.textContent=msg;el.classList.add('visible');
}
function ssMineNoticeTick(now){
 const el=$('ssMineFeedback');
 if(el&&el.classList.contains('visible')&&now-ssMineNoticeAt>2600)el.classList.remove('visible');
}
function ssCargoMissingMessage(id,qty=1){
 const need=SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS[id]*qty,load=ssCargoLoad(),remaining=Math.max(0,SS_CARGO_MAX-load);
 return `화물 ${load.toFixed(1)}/${SS_CARGO_MAX}kg · 남은 ${remaining.toFixed(1)}kg / ${MATERIAL_NAMES[id]||id} ${need.toFixed(1)}kg 필요 · 정거장에 입고하세요`;
}
function ssCargoFresh(){return {schemaVersion:1,carried:{},trainingKg:0,deliveredKg:0,deliveries:0,rescueTests:0};}
function ssCargoNormalize(c){
 const r=ssCargoFresh();
 if(!c||typeof c!=='object'||Array.isArray(c))return r;
 const safe=(v,max)=>Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=0?Math.min(max,v):0;
 for(const id of Object.keys(SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS)){
  const n=Number(c.carried&&c.carried[id]);
  if(Number.isSafeInteger(n)&&n>0)r.carried[id]=Math.min(n,100000);
 }
 r.trainingKg=0; // Ignore legacy experimental training weights on import; not available in production.
 r.deliveredKg=safe(c.deliveredKg,10000000);
 r.deliveries=Math.floor(safe(c.deliveries,100000));
 r.rescueTests=Math.floor(safe(c.rescueTests,100000));
 return r;
}
function ssCargoLedger(state=game){
 const c=state&&state.cargoTrial||ssCargoFresh();
 let kg=0;
 for(const [id,w] of Object.entries(SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS)){
  const carried=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(c.carried&&c.carried[id])||0));
  const held=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(state&&state.inv&&state.inv[id])||0));
  kg+=Math.min(carried,held)*w;
 }
 return kg;
}
function ssCargoLoad(state=game){return ssCargoLedger(state);}
function ssCargoRatio(state=game){return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(ssCargoLoad(state)-SS_CARGO_NORMAL)/(SS_CARGO_MAX-SS_CARGO_NORMAL)));}
function ssCargoMoveFactor(state=game){return 1-.20*ssCargoRatio(state);}
function ssCargoRopeFactor(state=game){return 1-.10*ssCargoRatio(state);}
function ssCargoCanCollect(id,qty=1,state=game){return !SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS[id]||ssCargoLoad(state)+SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS[id]*qty<=SS_CARGO_MAX+1e-7;}
function ssCargoCollect(id,qty){if(!SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS[id]||qty<=0)return;game.cargoTrial.carried[id]=(game.cargoTrial.carried[id]||0)+qty;}
function ssCargoReconcile(previous,draft){
 if(!draft.cargoTrial)return;
 for(const id of Object.keys(SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS)){
  const before=Math.floor(Number(previous?.inv?.[id])||0),after=Math.floor(Number(draft?.inv?.[id])||0);
  if(after<before)draft.cargoTrial.carried[id]=Math.max(0,(draft.cargoTrial.carried[id]||0)-(before-after));
 }
}
function ssCargoHud(){
 const b=$('ssCargoBadge');if(!b)return;
 const w=ssCargoLoad();
 b.textContent=`⚖ ${w.toFixed(1)}/${SS_CARGO_MAX}kg`;
 b.classList.toggle('over',w>SS_CARGO_NORMAL&&w<SS_CARGO_MAX-1e-6);
 b.classList.toggle('full',w>=SS_CARGO_MAX-1e-6);
 b.setAttribute('aria-label',`원정 화물 ${w.toFixed(1)}kg, 정상 ${SS_CARGO_NORMAL}kg, 최대 ${SS_CARGO_MAX}kg. 화물 메뉴 열기`);
}
function ssCargoDeposit(){
 const station=closestStation(),open=station&&game.transport.unlocked.includes(station.id);
 if(!open){flash('개방된 승강장 가까이에서만 화물을 확정할 수 있어요.');return false;}
 const ok=safeMarketTransaction(draft=>{
  const w=ssCargoLoad(draft);if(w<=0)return false;
  draft.cargoTrial.deliveredKg+=w;
  draft.cargoTrial.deliveries++;
  draft.cargoTrial.trainingKg=0;
  draft.cargoTrial.carried={};
  // All mined resources remain in inv, which is the pre-existing official inventory.
  return true;
 });
 if(ok){ssCargoMenu();flash('정거장 입고 완료 · 채굴물 보존');}else flash('화물이 없거나 저장하지 못했어요.');
 return ok;
}
function ssCargoMenu(){
 const c=game.cargoTrial,w=ssCargoLoad(),pct=Math.min(100,w/SS_CARGO_MAX*100),station=closestStation();
 const stationOk=!!(station&&game.transport.unlocked.includes(station.id));
 const status=w>=SS_CARGO_MAX-.001?'최대 적재 · 채굴 광석 추가 수집 불가':w>SS_CARGO_NORMAL?'과적 감속 구간':'정상 적재';
 const items=Object.entries(c.carried).filter(([id,n])=>SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS[id]&&n>0).map(([id,n])=>`${MATERIAL_NAMES[id]} ${Math.min(n,Math.floor(game.inv[id]||0))}개`).join(' · ');
 showModal('원정 화물',`<p>업데이트 이후 새로 채굴한 광물·보석만 운반 중량에 포함됩니다. 흙·돌·기존 보유품과 장비는 무게에서 제외돼요.</p>
  <div class="ss-cargo-summary"><div><small>현재 중량 / 최대</small><b>${w.toFixed(1)} / ${SS_CARGO_MAX}kg</b></div><div><small>남은 용량 · 정상 ${SS_CARGO_NORMAL}kg</small><b>${Math.max(0,SS_CARGO_MAX-w).toFixed(1)}kg</b></div></div>
 <div class="ss-cargo-meter" role="progressbar" aria-label="원정 화물 중량" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="30" aria-valuenow="${w.toFixed(1)}"><div class="ss-cargo-fill ${w>=SS_CARGO_MAX-.001?'full':w>SS_CARGO_NORMAL?'over':''}" style="width:${pct.toFixed(1)}%"></div></div>
 <p><strong>${status}</strong></p>
 <div class="ss-cargo-summary"><div><small>걷기 속도</small><b>${Math.round(ssCargoMoveFactor()*100)}%</b></div><div><small>로프 상승 속도</small><b>${Math.round(ssCargoRopeFactor()*100)}%</b></div></div>
   <div class="ss-cargo-ledger"><strong>이번 원정 화물:</strong> ${items||'아직 없음'}<br><strong>광물 1개 무게:</strong> ${Object.entries(SS_CARGO_WEIGHTS).map(([id,weight])=>`${MATERIAL_NAMES[id]} ${weight.toFixed(2)}kg`).join(' · ')}<br><small>남은 용량 ${Math.max(0,SS_CARGO_MAX-w).toFixed(1)}kg · 다음 광물 무게가 남은 용량보다 크면 30kg 이전에도 채굴이 제한돼요.<br>입고 ${c.deliveries}회 · 누적 운반 ${c.deliveredKg.toFixed(1)}kg</small></div>
 <div class="ss-cargo-controls"><button id="ssCargoDeposit" ${stationOk&&w>0?'':'disabled'}>정거장 입고</button><button id="ssCargoBackup">월드 백업</button></div>
 <p class="note">입고는 운반량을 확정하고 하중을 비우지만 광물 재고는 그대로 보존합니다. 위험 원정의 아이템 손실은 미적용입니다. 승강장 입고는 개방된 역 근처에서만 가능해요. 실제 로프 스윙·도약 성능은 감속하지 않습니다.</p>`);
 $('dialog').classList.add('ss-ui-modal');
 $('ssCargoDeposit').onclick=ssCargoDeposit;
 $('ssCargoBackup').onclick=exportGame;
}


// SANDSTAR 2.13: original PCM mini-SFX embedded for Android content:// offline mode.
const SOUND_PREF_KEY='sandstar-audio-v1';
const SANDSTAR_SFX = {"earth_hit":"","stone_hit":"","ore_hit":"","break_block":"","pickup_ore":"","rare_find":""};
const sfxState={enabled:true,volume:.30,ctx:null,master:null,buffers:{},ready:0,unsupported:false,lastPlayed:{},plays:0};
function loadSoundPref(){try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(SOUND_PREF_KEY);if(!raw)return;
 const pref=JSON.parse(raw);if(typeof pref.enabled==='boolean')sfxState.enabled=pref.enabled;
 if(Number.isFinite(pref.volume))sfxState.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,pref.volume));}catch(_){} }
function saveSoundPref(){try{localStorage.setItem(SOUND_PREF_KEY,JSON.stringify({enabled:sfxState.enabled,volume:sfxState.volume}))}catch(_){} }
loadSoundPref();
function armAudio(){
 if(!sfxState.enabled||sfxState.unsupported)return;
 const Ctx=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
 if(!Ctx){sfxState.unsupported=true;return;}
 try{
  if(!sfxState.ctx){
   sfxState.ctx=new Ctx();sfxState.master=sfxState.ctx.createGain();
   sfxState.master.gain.value=sfxState.volume;sfxState.master.connect(sfxState.ctx.destination);
   Object.entries(SANDSTAR_SFX).forEach(([name,b64])=>{
    const binary=atob(b64);const data=new Uint8Array(binary.length);
    for(let i=0;i<binary.length;i++)data[i]=binary.charCodeAt(i);
    sfxState.ctx.decodeAudioData(data.buffer).then(buffer=>{sfxState.buffers[name]=buffer;sfxState.ready++;}).catch(()=>{});
   });
  }
  if(sfxState.ctx.state==='suspended')sfxState.ctx.resume().catch(()=>{});
 }catch(_){sfxState.unsupported=true;}
}
function playSound(name,rate=1){
 if(!sfxState.enabled||sfxState.volume<=0)return false;
 if(!sfxState.ctx||!sfxState.buffers[name])return false;
 const now=performance.now(),limit=name.includes('hit')?100:35;
 if(now-(sfxState.lastPlayed[name]||-10000)<limit)return false;
 sfxState.lastPlayed[name]=now;
 try{const source=sfxState.ctx.createBufferSource();source.buffer=sfxState.buffers[name];
 source.playbackRate.value=Math.max(.72,Math.min(1.35,rate));source.connect(sfxState.master);
 source.start(0);sfxState.plays++;return true;}catch(_){return false;}
}
function setSoundEnabled(value){sfxState.enabled=!!value;saveSoundPref();if(sfxState.enabled)armAudio();}
function setSoundVolume(value){sfxState.volume=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number(value)||0));
 if(sfxState.master)sfxState.master.gain.value=sfxState.volume;saveSoundPref();}

// SANDSTAR M2.5-C OST prototype: self-contained, sample-accurate WebAudio main-theme loop.
// Separate from sandstar-audio-v1, so existing SFX preferences, save schema and SFX mixing remain untouched.
const SS_BGM_PREF_KEY='sandstar-bgm-v1';
const SS_BGM_OGG_BASE64='
